This Privacy Policy applies to information that is identified or can reasonably be identifiable to natural persons (“Personal Information”). You are not legally obligated to provide the personal information that is specified below, however failure to provide it may impede our ability to provide certain services to you. As part of your engagement with us and by using any of our services or when browsing the Website, we process your personal information in accordance with the Privacy Protection Law, 1981 (hereinafter: "PPL"), and any other legal provisions that apply to us. Personal Information We Collect and how we collect it Information you provide directly: When you visit our Website, you may provide us with your personal information directly in the following ways: • You can provide us with your contact information such as first and last name, e-mail address, mobile number and additional information you choose to provide if you try to contact us through our contact channel on the Website. • You can provide us with your contact information and additional information you choose to provide when you send a request for customer support. • You may file an application for a job opening through the Career page on the Website, providing your name, Email address, phone number, copy of your CV or link to your LinkedIn profile. • You can provide us with your information through the Website when you ask for a demo. The information you may provide includes your name and Email address; you may also voluntarily provide your phone number, company name and job title. • You may participate voluntarily in surveys we may conduct from time to time and provide information through the survey. Information we collect automatically when you visit our Website: We employ various technologies that allow us to monitor the activity and traffic on the Website for the purpose of maintaining information security, improving the efficiency of the services we provide, as well as for statistics of the Website and for improvement of our service and Website. Such technologies include cookies, web beacons, and other storage technologies. The use of cookies facilitates your identification when you revisit our websites. Additionally, the cookies will monitor your activities and automatically collect information such as: IP address, connection dates, duration of your visit, version of the operating system, type of browser, IP-based location and domain name. Some of these technologies are provided by third parties vendors. This usage is also subject to those third parties’ terms of use and privacy policies. In particular, we use Google Analytics. jobs.title: R&D Mechanical Engineer Israel, Caesarea Full time
jobs.description: ForSight Robotics By clicking “Accept”, you agree to the storing of cookies on your device to enhance site navigation, analyze site usage, and assist in our marketing efforts. View our Privacy Policy for more information. Accept Decline R&D R&D Mechanical Engineer Israel, Caesarea Full time Description Who we are We are here to improve lives by restoring sight worldwide by a robotic platform for vision saving surgery. Our company will improve the way ophthalmic surgery is delivered to vision impaired individuals now and for decades to come. We are rapidly growing, funded by leading international VCs, and are looking to expand our skilled multi-disciplinary team. Joining us is an opportunity to work towards saving vision across the globe, collaborating with others to realize a dream, and tackle an enormous challenge that will help drive your career forward. Who we are looking for We are looking for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our R&D team and contribute to the development of an advanced robotic platform for ophthalmic surgery. The role involves designing, developing, and testing precision mechanisms and test systems as part of a complex, multidisciplinary medical device. You will collaborate closely with engineers across multiple disciplines and take ownership throughout the development lifecycle—from initial concept and detailed design through prototyping, integration, testing, and transfer to production Responsibilities Design and develop mechanisms, assemblies, and test rigs throughout the product development lifecycle—from concept generation and detailed design through prototyping, integration, verification, and transfer to production. Design mechanical solutions incorporating motors, sensors, bearings, gears, and other precision components. Develop and execute mechanical tests and experiments to evaluate design performance and verify engineering requirements. Prepare and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, calculations, test protocols, reports, and engineering change documentation. Collaborate closely with systems, software, electronics, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams to develop multidisciplinary solutions. Support hands-on prototype assembly, integration, troubleshooting, and testing. Identify mechanical design challenges and develop practical, data-driven solutions. Contribute to design reviews and the continuous improvement of products and development processes. Requirements B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering. At least 5 years of experience in mechanical design and product development. Demonstrated experience designing complex mechanisms, assemblies, or electromechanical systems. Experience designing multidisciplinary systems – an advantage. Experience with mechanisms incorporating motors, sensors, bearing systems, gears, and/or precision components – an advantage. Experience designing test rigs, fixtures, or experimental setups – an advantage. Strong proficiency in SolidWorks, including assemblies and detailed engineering drawings. Familiarity with PLM systems and ECO/ECN processes – an advantage. Familiarity with Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles – an advantage. Strong technical problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Hands-on approach and ability to work effectively with prototypes and hardware. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic development environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and execution. Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Independent learner with a proactive mindset. Fluent in Hebrew and English. Application Fill form below to apply ‍

Accept Decline R&D Algorithm Engineer Israel, Caesarea Full time Description We are here to improve lives by restoring sight worldwide by a robotic platform for vision saving surgery. Our company will improve the way ophthalmic surgery is delivered to vision impaired individuals now and for decades to come. We are rapidly growing, funded by leading international VCs, and are looking to expand our small, motivated, multi-disciplinary and phenomenal team. Joining us is an opportunity to work towards saving vision across the globe, collaborating with others to realize a dream, and tackle an enormous challenge that will help drive your career forward. We are seeking a highly skilled Algorithm Engineer with a strong focus on classical computer vision, image processing, and problem-solving. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in end-to-end development — from research and prototyping to production deployment — and a passion for applying advanced algorithms to transform the field of medical robotics. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge algorithms to enhance the accuracy, robustness, and efficiency of robotic surgical systems. Apply deep learning, computer vision, and advanced data analysis techniques to solve challenging perception and decision-making problems. Lead end-to-end development cycles: problem definition, algorithm design, implementation, optimization, and integration into real-time systems. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including software, hardware, and clinical experts, to ensure algorithms meet system and clinical requirements. Validate and refine algorithms through simulation, lab testing, and clinical feedback. Requirements: Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in algorithm development, with a strong track record in classical computer vision, image processing, and 3D/geometric computer vision. Hands-on experience developing camera-based computer vision algorithms, including areas such as camera calibration, SLAM, visual odometry, 3D vision, pose estimation, or related geometric vision techniques. Hands-on experience in the full development lifecycle — from concept and algorithm design through implementation, testing, optimization, integration, and deployment. Solid mathematical foundation, with a strong understanding of geometry and its application to computer vision problems. Proficiency in Python and/or C++. Experience in robotics, control systems, autonomous navigation, sensor fusion, or medical devices – an advantage. Experience with Deep Learning and modern learning-based computer vision methods – an advantage. Experience with validation of algorithm solutions for medical devices – an advantage. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. Application Fill form below to apply ‍

Accept Decline Operations & Engineering Junior Technical Support Engineer Israel, Caesarea Full time Description Who are we We are here to improve lives by restoring sight worldwide by a robotic platform for vision saving surgery. Our company will improve the way ophthalmic surgery is delivered to vision impaired individuals now and for decades to come. We are rapidly growing, funded by leading international VCs, and are looking to expand our small, motivated, multi-disciplinary and phenomenal team. Joining us is an opportunity to work towards saving vision across the globe, collaborating with others to realize a dream, and tackle an enormous challenge that will help drive your career forward. Who we are looking for We are looking for a Technical support to join our growing robotics startup. This role is hands-on and multidisciplinary, involving installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and on-site support of complex robotic systems. The systems combine mechanics, hardware, electronics, and advanced software, and require strong system-level understanding. The position includes work at our company’s facilities as well as international travel, primarily for system installations, demos, and field troubleshooting. As part of our rapidly growing, small, motivated, and multi-disciplinary team, this position is the first dedicated role in its domain, providing a unique opportunity to contribute to a new area within the company. Responsibilities Maintain, test, and troubleshoot robotic systems at the company’s facilities Install, calibrate, and commission robotic systems at customer and partner sites abroad Lead on-site system setup and troubleshooting during demos and early deployments Diagnose and resolve hardware, mechanical, and software issues in the field Perform hands-on replacement and repair of mechanical and electromechanical components Work closely with R&D teams (software, mechanical, electrical, algorithms) to deeply understand the system Gather knowledge from internal engineering teams and apply it independently in the field Provide technical feedback from the field to improve system robustness and usability Document issues, procedures, and best practices Requirements B.Sc. degree in Mechanical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering – a must. Strong hands-on technical orientation and a genuine interest in understanding complex robotic and multidisciplinary systems- must. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate problems when no predefined troubleshooting procedure or documentation is available-must. Ability to understand interactions between mechanical, electrical, software, and computer-related subsystems-must. Ability and willingness to assemble, disassemble, test, and replace mechanical and electromechanical components. Good computer skills; familiarity with Linux, networking, logs, and software environments is an advantage. High learning capability, technical curiosity, and willingness to independently explore and learn unfamiliar systems. Ability to take technical ownership of system issues from initial investigation through resolution. Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with R&D, Engineering, and Operations teams. Good English – written and spoken. Willingness to travel internationally for system installations, demos, and technical support. Application Fill form below to apply ‍

Collaborate closely with R&D, Operations, and management to resolve financial discrepancies, support project needs, and ensure accurate financial reporting. Oversee tax reporting, annual filings, and statutory compliance, coordinating with external auditors and advisors. Strong working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. High proficiency in ERP systems and advanced Excel skills.
